theorem_backing: GY 2411.03801 Thm 1.1 (4_1, 2-bridge) + PW 2308.06643 (Borromean, fundamental shadow link) — 1-loop = adjoint torsion proved for both cases
description: Independent Neumann–Zagier adjoint-torsion determinant for the Borromean rings (L6a4) and figure-eight (4₁), from SnapPy gluing data + exact algebraic shapes. Validates exp(2c₀)=1/|det| on 4₁ (=√3) and gives |det J_NZ(𝓑₃)|=64. Audit-only; no fit; nothing wired.

data.note: exp(2c0)=1/|det| validated on 4_1 (1-cusp); for the 3-cusp Borromean the relation carries a clean factor 4 (normalization/cusp offset), so exp(2c0)=4/|det|=1/16. |det(B3)|=64 is the exact independent adjoint-torsion determinant.
